description: This file is a shell script intended for testing the behavior of Git commands under various invalid argument conditions and usage scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the commands within and verifies expected output.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands expecting them to fail, verifies exit status.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Checks the number of lines in a specified file.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within a file.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with a specified message.
